rawContent: Justice is not served. George Floyd is still gone.Justice is Black people being able to simple live without fear of dying at the hands of those sworn to serve and protect. A guilty verdict is not a replacement for life lost #BlackLivesMatter = #DefundPolice #GeorgeFloyd

Today @ColumbusPolice shot and killed 15yo #MakiyahBryant after she called them for help. This is why we Shouldn’t celebrate #DerekChauvin being found guilty. They’re still killing us. We need to #DefundThePolice and #AbolishThePolice completely. #BlackLivesMatter #SayHerName
